---BEGIN INSTRUCTIONS---
[AGENT: backend_coder]
FILE: ToDoApp/app.py
LANGUAGE: python
FRAMEWORK: flask
DESCRIPTION: Flask application with API endpoints for CRUD operations on to-do items.
REQUIREMENTS:
- Create a Flask application instance.
- Define API endpoints for GET /todos, POST /todos, PUT /todos/<id>, and DELETE /todos/<id>.
- Implement functions to retrieve, add, update, and delete to-do items from the todo_data.json file.
- Handle request parameters and body data.
- Return appropriate JSON responses for each endpoint.
- Implement error handling and input validation.
- Use the Flask framework to create the application and define the API endpoints.
- Import necessary libraries (flask, json).
- Define the Flask application instance (app).
- Implement the following functions: get_todos, add_todo, update_todo, delete_todo.
CONTEXT:
This Python file will implement the backend logic for the ToDoApp. It will interact with the todo_data.json file to store and retrieve to-do items. The frontend (script.js) will communicate with these API endpoints.
[/AGENT]
---END INSTRUCTIONS---
